newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles buys German rental firm.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles buys German rental firm.

text.p: Australian diversified transport group Brambles Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it had bought a German access equipment rental business, Gardemann Arbeitsbuhnen GmbH, for around A$90 million.
Brambles said Gardemann operated from 22 locations across Germany and its rental fleet was broadly similar to the light access business in Australia of Brambles' Wreckair unit.

It said Gardemann rented a range of specialised access equipment including scissor lifts and mobile booms on short and medium term maintenance and installation contracts. It said the German company's customer base was widely spread, covering general industry, government authorities, telecommunications and construction.

Brambles chief executive John Fletcher said Brambles had now established solid foundations for growth in Europe in waste management, equipment rental and industrial services, outside its established pallet and rail wagon activities.
